figmaHints:
/* ================================================================
       DS Avatar Component — token-based styles dari tokens.css
       Figma source: Size=Extra Large/Large/Medium/Small, Status=None, Presence=Online
       Color-Background-Blue-Bold  → --color-blue-b200
       Color-Notification-Online   → --color-green-g300
       Color-Notification-Background → --color-neutral-n0
    ================================================================ */

transition.raw:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  border-color 160ms ease
transition.resolved:
transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94),
                  border-color 160ms ease

transition.raw: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, background-color 150ms ease
transition.resolved: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, background-color 150ms ease

transition.raw: background-color var(--transition-fast), color var(--transition-fast), border-color var(--transition-fast)
transition.resolved: background-color 150ms ease-in-out, color 150ms ease-in-out, border-color 150ms ease-in-out
